status: PROPOSED ONLY — NOTHING IMPLEMENTED, NO STAGE AUTHORIZED
rule: each stage is separately authorized. No stage may be started because the previous one succeeded; the product owner authorizes each one.
gateInvariant: EXPERT_VERIFIER_V3_DEVELOPMENT_ENABLED stays the literal false through every stage below. Customer activation is not in this sequence at all.

A0.name: EXERCISE THE EXISTING ARCHITECTURE ON THE FROZEN ROWS
A0.why: Finding 4 — the §179 failures occurred on the first-pass path, where no ledger, factKey or binding exists. The architecture that would make a displaced question structurally refusable was not running, so §179 is not evidence against it. This is the cheapest experiment that could overturn the whole recommendation.
scope: construct owed facts for the ten frozen §179 rows from the DETERMINISTIC decomposition only
derive acceptableEvidence where a governed record backs a finding; expect null on most
project the request with projectOwedFact() and hash it
record how many facts each row yields, how many carry a criterion, and what the projection looks like for HR-04, HR-05 and HR-07
prohibited: authoring owed facts by hand for these rows — that would re-author the frozen instrument
any change to the frozen truth, row text or the §179 evidence
A0.decisionItInforms: whether a settlement declaration is needed at all, or whether an explicit owed fact plus the existing three-token declaration already changes the failing path
A0.exitCriteria: a written record of what the existing architecture would have shown the model on HR-04, and whether a governed criterion exists for its guarding fact

A.name: TYPES + OBSERVABILITY ONLY
scope: the settlement declaration shape as types, with no producer and no consumer

the observability record from Q9 — factKey, target, provenance class, evidence observed, property claimed, assessment, reason, admission codes, final status and authority, binding, nomination origin, coverage state
A.exitCriteria: types compile, nothing calls them, existing suites unchanged

B.name: PROVIDER PROJECTION / DECLARATION SCHEMA
scope: extend the verifier-v3 request schema and instruction with the per-fact settlement declaration
keep the existing three-token bookkeeping declaration unchanged and additive to it
project the settlement target from acceptableEvidence.requirement, or explicit absence
prohibited: projecting any adjudication label, human disposition, pass/fail status, historical rate or expected question
B.exitCriteria: the request is byte-stable and hashable before it is sent, as the current projection already is

C.name: STRUCTURAL VERIFIER CHECKS
scope: new admission codes for the settlement declaration, each a property of FORM

verbatim-span byte equality; exactly one declaration per supplied fact; field presence; enum membership; the settled-and-bound contradiction; the null-criterion flag; the existing forbidden-field echo check
a settlement claim mints an ArbitrationRequest-shaped object with settles:false and factStatusUnchanged:true
prohibited: ANY comparison of evidenceEstablishes against requirement — similarity, embedding, keyword, overlap, regex or property matcher
any code path that lets a provider claim move the ledger
C.exitCriteria: a provider claim of SETTLED demonstrably leaves the fact UNRESOLVED and its clarification entitlement unchanged

D.name: INACTIVE SETTLEMENT PIPELINE + THE HUMAN REVIEW SURFACE
scope: wire the stage end to end behind the literal-false gate
build the review surface that drains the arbitration/settlement-claim queue — the consumer that has never existed
the ADMISSIBLE_EVIDENCE transition producer, reachable ONLY from a recorded human review, in the DEVELOPMENT population
prohibited: a provider or deterministic producer of ADMISSIBLE_EVIDENCE
admitting DEVELOPMENT_HUMAN_TRUTH or ADJUDICATION_LABEL provenance into a production ledger
feeding a recorded review back into provider input
D.note: this is the stage that makes SETTLED_BY_EVIDENCE reachable for the first time. It is also the stage most likely to be got wrong, because a review surface that is tedious will be rubber-stamped.
D.exitCriteria: SETTLED_BY_EVIDENCE is reachable by exactly one route and that route requires a recorded human act

E.name: ZERO-CALL SYNTHETIC PROOFS
scope: drive every structural check through the REAL admission path with synthetic payloads whose answers are known in advance, in the style of the §177 and §179 preflights

prove the negative cases explicitly: a SETTLED claim does not move the ledger; a non-verbatim span is refused; a null-criterion claim is flagged and cannot reach SETTLED_BY_EVIDENCE; no forbidden field is projected
prove no deterministic semantic comparison exists anywhere in the new code
prohibited: testing a duplicate of the derivation rather than the derivation itself — the §175 attempt-1 lesson
E.exitCriteria: the suite fails loudly if any structural guarantee is removed

F.name: HOSTED DEVELOPMENT VALIDATION
F.providerCalls: > 0 — SEPARATELY AUTHORIZED, NOT PART OF THIS SEQUENCE'S AUTHORIZATION
designRequirements: preregistered REPLICATE design at one frozen identity, per the §179 pattern that worked
replicate count fixed before any output is seen
per-row rates reported before any pooled figure; a disagreeing row has a RATE, not a pass
BOTH recall and precision must be preserved — a recall gain with a precision regression is not success
the comparator problem must be stated: without a replicated control at the previous identity, no causal effect size is available in either direction
F.note: the frozen ten-row instrument has now been spent three times. Whether it can carry another comparison, or whether a fresh instrument is required, is itself a question for that authorization.

G.status: OUT OF SCOPE AND FAR OFF
blockedBy: HUMAN_AUTHORITATIVE_SILENCE_ROWS beyond the current frozen ten
the customer-visible question surface is not designed and its burden is unmeasurable
